tools.name: lookup_drug_inventory
tools.description: Look up current inventory status for a pharmaceutical drug, including stock quantity, reorder status, and storage conditions.

drug_name.description: Fuzzy search on drug_name field in drug_master.

drug_id.description: Exact lookup by drug UUID from drug_master.

storage_location_id.description: Filter results by storage location identifier (e.g., SHELF-A3).

tools.name: check_drug_interactions
tools.description: Check for known drug interactions between two or more drugs, returning risk grades and clinical management recommendations.

drug_ids.description: List of drug UUIDs to check for interactions (2 to 5 drugs).

tools.name: get_risk_grade
tools.description: Retrieve the risk grade for a specific drug-drug interaction pair, returning the most recent assessment including clinical consequence and management recommendation.

tools.name: get_iot_sensor_status
tools.description: Get the latest IoT sensor readings for a specific storage location, including temperature, humidity, and alert status.

storage_location_id.description: Storage location identifier to query (e.g., SHELF-A3, FRIDGE-02).
